Rewards and redemption

Paying your expenses with a Credit Card is a smart way to spend money as it’s the best way to earn reward points, air miles, cashback and other perks. With Citi PayAll– a first-of-its-kind payment solution in the UAE – Credit Cardholders can turn their big payments into rewards that they can maximize over time.
Debit Cards: They do not offer rewards points
Credit Cards: Users get access to a wide range of privileges and benefits such as travel discounts, cash backs, cash rebates, discounts on bills, etc.
Minimum Payment Due is calculated as 2.74% of the current balance on Statement of Account, plus, if applicable
InstaLoan processing fee or AED 100, whichever is higher.
If your Current Balance is less than AED 100, then your Minimum Payment Due will be equal to your Current Balance
